asks.cbu: CBU or CVU (22 digits) or alias

twoStep.verifyBody: Open your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator…) and type the 6-digit code for Northstack.
twoStep.recoveryBody: Type one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on two-step verification. Each one works once.
twoStep.expired: That sign-in took too long or had too many tries. Sign in again.
twoStep.badCode: That code isn't right. Try the newest one in your app.
twoStep.enrollBody: Your role requires it: besides your password, signing in will ask for a code from an app on your phone.
twoStep.stepApp: Install an authenticator app on your phone: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy or your password manager.
twoStep.stepScan: In the app, add an account and scan this QR.
twoStep.stepCode: Type the 6-digit code the app shows.
twoStep.qrLabel: QR to add Northstack to your authenticator app
twoStep.cantScan: Can't scan it? Type the key instead
twoStep.codesBody: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you in once. Save them somewhere safe (a password manager, or printed). You won't see them again.
twoStep.codesFileNote: Each code works only once. Keep this file somewhere safe.
twoStep.cardLead: Besides your password, signing in asks for a code from an app on your phone. If someone gets your password, they still can't get in.
twoStep.codesLow: You have few recovery codes left. Create new ones.
twoStep.devicesForgotten: Done: the next sign-in on those devices asks for a code.
twoStep.requiredNote: Your role (account owner, billing or payments) requires it, so it can't be turned off.
twoStep.requiredOff: Your role requires two-step verification. Turn it on now.
twoStep.disableBody: Type a code from your app to turn it off.
twoStep.regenerateBody: Type a code from your app. Your current recovery codes will stop working.
twoStep.signInAgain: Your password was changed. Sign in with it and your code.
twoStep.resetBody: They'll be signed out and will set it up again the next time they sign in (if their role requires it) or can turn it on from their profile. Use it when someone lost their phone and their recovery codes.
twoStep.resetOwner: Only Northstack support can reset the account owner's.
